installation: Guided: composed into the consuming project, then deployed through the Agent Spec rail. Installation by URL is not offered.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — dossiers communs
modules.summary: Shared case files: goal, owner, references, next action, blocker and internal closing proof; management sees only the files each person may access.
modules.use_when: Teams track shared files or cases in spreadsheets or ad hoc tables.

modules.name: Routine quotidienne — dossiers, mémoire et temps
modules.summary: Daily routine: prepares the day's context, consults a chosen memory revision, reviews a file and records declared active time.
modules.use_when: People start each day by gathering the same context by hand.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — administration entreprise
modules.summary: Bounded administration of people, existing identities, access per department and revocation of mandates.
modules.use_when: Directory, roles and per-department rights are rebuilt by hand around internal tools.

modules.name: Company in a Box — Marketing de lancement
modules.summary: Launch marketing journey: campaign, content, trial request, follow-up and first confirmed result.
modules.use_when: A launch is run through scattered scripts, forms and spreadsheets.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Accompagnement — raccordement mémoire
modules.summary: Connects the follow-up role to company memory: search, consult and propose a selected extract.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Contenu — raccordement mémoire
modules.summary: Connects the content role to company memory, including a draft prepared from a validated, cited revision.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Veille — raccordement mémoire
modules.summary: Connects the watch role to company memory: search, consult and propose a selected extract.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Accompagnement
modules.summary: Customer follow-up role: save and share follow-up files, with guarded actions.
modules.use_when: Follow-up of customers or users is tracked by hand.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Contenu
modules.summary: Content role: save, share and review content drafts with completion checks.
modules.use_when: Content drafts move between people without a shared review step.

modules.name: Company-in-a-Box — Veille
modules.summary: Manual watch: explicit import of sources and facts, manual assignment, field and freshness checks.
modules.use_when: Scripts import and sort sources for a watch or monitoring activity.

modules.name: Company Memory
modules.summary: Company memory: capture of sources, proposals, manual review, cited consultation and indexing for search.
modules.use_when: Knowledge lives in scattered documents and answers must cite reviewed sources.
